name: Special Economic Zones
note: Five SEZs, including Bagamoyo and the Dodoma critical-minerals and technology hub, built on public infrastructure to draw private capital into industry.

name: Diaspora bonds and remittance-linked instruments
note: Tapping Tanzanians abroad through bonds and products backed by their remittances.

name: Climate and green finance
note: Raised through accredited climate entities, green bonds included, for climate-resilient investment.
meta: Toward the USD 4bn/year climate goal · ~TZS 8 to 10tn

name: Carbon credit market
note: Selling verified carbon credits from forests, wetlands and other ecosystems.
meta: Up to USD 3bn a year by 2030/31 · ~TZS 12 to 15tn

name: Blended finance
note: Concessional funds used to de-risk projects and pull in private money for infrastructure, energy and MSMEs.

name: Asset monetisation and land value capture
note: Freeing capital locked in public assets and capturing rising land values.

name: Pension and long-term savings
note: Channelling formal pension schemes and other long-term savings into development finance.

name: Development Finance Institutions (TADB & TIB)
note: Recapitalised through PPPs and blended finance so they can leverage more private capital.

name: Public corporation bonds and equity
note: Public corporations issuing corporate, infrastructure and green bonds, and taking on strategic equity partners.

name: Public-Private Partnerships
note: Sharing risk and capital with private investors on major bankable projects.

name: Digital platforms and crowdfunding
note: Expanding MSME formalisation and digital finance to widen the pool of investors.

name: Development and impact bonds
note: Outcome-linked and results-based finance piloted in high-impact sectors.
